summary: Class counsel raised fee terms in their opening proposals, and fees were negotiated alongside the class fund before final class relief was settled. The transcript expressly links fee reductions to class benefit by directing unawarded fees to the class, but the fee negotiations were court-reviewed, non-clear-sailing, and class-protective. There is no clear evidence that plaintiffs prioritized firm economics over the class, that defense leveraged fee interests, that defense used reverse-auction tactics, or that the court declaration was misleading.
